<TITLE>EX-10.1</TITLE>
</HEAD>
 <BODY BGCOLOR="WHITE" STYLE="line-height:Normal">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>Exhibit 10.1 </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This Employment
Agreement (this <B>&#8220;Agreement&#8221;</B>) is entered into as of September&nbsp;5, 2026 (the <B>&#8220;Commencement Date&#8221;</B>), by and between CalPrivate Bank, a California state-chartered commercial bank (together with its successors and
permitted assigns, collectively, the <B>&#8220;Bank&#8221;</B>), and Cory Stewart (<B>&#8220;Executive&#8221;</B>), with reference to the following: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">A. The Bank considers Executive&#8217;s services, managerial skills, and business experience important to the Bank&#8217;s operations and
strategic objectives and desires to retain the Executive as a Bank officer and employee on the terms and conditions set forth herein; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">B.
Executive is expected to contribute to the Bank&#8217;s profitability, growth and financial strength. Executive will serve as a Bank officer and employee and will receive compensation for such service; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">C. Executive desires to be a Bank officer and employee on the terms and conditions set forth herein; and </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">D. The Bank and Executive desire to enter into a formal agreement setting forth the terms and conditions of Executive&#8217;s employment,
including outlining Executive&#8217;s general duties as the Bank&#8217;s Chief Financial Officer, and setting Executive&#8217;s compensation for services in such capacities. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants, promises and obligations set forth herein, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby
acknowledged, the parties agree as follows: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1. <U>Employment</U>. The Bank hereby agrees to employ Executive, and Executive agrees to be
employed by the Bank, subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, from the Commencement Date through the third anniversary thereof (the <B>&#8220;</B><B>Expiration Date</B><B>&#8221;</B>), provided that Executive&#8217;s employment with
the Bank can be terminated by either Executive or the Bank at any time, with or without notice, Cause or Good Reason, before the Expiration Date pursuant to <U>Paragraphs 4</U> and <U>5</U>. Executive shall serve as the Bank&#8217;s Chief Financial
Officer and shall have duties, authority, and responsibilities as described herein and as shall be from time to time prescribed by the Bank&#8217;s Chief Executive Officer and/or Board of Directors (the <B>&#8220;</B><B>Board</B><B>&#8221;</B>).
Executive&#8217;s employment with the Bank shall automatically terminate on the Expiration Date and, subject to <U>Paragraph</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;9.14</U>, this Agreement shall be of no force or effect thereafter, unless Executive and the Bank have
entered into an amendment of this Agreement extending the Expiration Date, as set forth in <U>Paragraph 9.2</U>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">2. <U>Best Efforts</U>.
Executive shall faithfully discharge Executive&#8217;s duties and responsibilities to the best of Executive&#8217;s abilities, with reasonable diligence, and shall abide by all policies, procedures and decisions made by the Bank, as well as all
applicable federal, state and local laws, regulations and ordinances. During Executive&#8217;s employment, Executive shall act in the Bank&#8217;s best interests at all times; shall devote substantially all of Executive&#8217;s business time and
attention to the Bank&#8217;s business and affairs; and shall not have other employment, consulting, or independent contractor work that directly or indirectly: (i)&nbsp;conflicts with any of the Bank&#8217;s interests; (ii)&nbsp;negatively affects
Executive&#8217;s job performance; or (iii)&nbsp;infringes upon the time required by Executive to faithfully perform Executive&#8217;s duties and responsibilities to the best of Executive&#8217;s ability. In order to ensure that no conflict exists,
Executive agrees not to engage in any outside employment, consulting, or independent contractor work of any kind without the Board&#8217;s prior written approval. Executive shall not be entitled to receive any additional compensation for
Executive&#8217;s service as a member of the Board, or as a director, officer or employee of any parent entity holding at least 50% of the outstanding voting power of the Bank (a &#8220;<B>Holding Company</B>&#8221;), or any subsidiary of the Bank
or any Holding Company. The Bank and Executive acknowledge that, as of the date of this Agreement, the Bank is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Private Bancorp of America, Inc., a California corporation (&#8220;<B>PBAM</B>&#8221;), which serves as the
Bank&#8217;s Holding Company. The parties further agree and confirm that Executive has been or may in the future be appointed as an officer of PBAM. Executive is or may be required pursuant to this Agreement to perform the duties assigned by the
PBAM board of directors and under the PBAM corporate governance documentation, and the parties acknowledge that Executive&#8217;s availability for and performance of such duties are a material inducement to the Bank entering into this Agreement.
</P> <P STYLE="font-size:18pt; margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3. <U>Compensation and Benefits</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.1 <U>Salary</U>. The Bank shall pay Executive a minimum annualized salary at the rate of $425,000, less required deductions and taxes, due
and payable in accordance with the Bank&#8217;s policy for the scheduling of salary payments to employees as in effect from time to time and applicable wage payment and tax laws (the <B>&#8220;</B><B>Base Salary</B><B>&#8221;</B>). The Base Salary
shall be evaluated on an annual basis by the Board and may be adjusted by the Board in its sole discretion. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.2 <U>Withholding and
Deductions</U>. The Bank shall withhold and/or deduct from any and all compensation, salary or other payments, all taxes and other deductions required to be deducted or withheld under any provision of law (including, but not limited to, social
security payments and income tax withholding) now in effect or which may become effective any time during Executive&#8217;s employment with the Bank. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.3 <U>Expense Reimbursement</U>. The Bank will reimburse Executive for all ordinary and necessary expenses incurred by Executive on behalf of
the Bank, subject to Bank policy as in effect from time to time and any approved individual budget, to the extent consistent with applicable law. Executive shall provide adequate documentation of all expenses for which reimbursement is sought. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.4 <U>Benefits</U>. Executive will be entitled to participate in any employee benefit plan that the Bank has adopted or may adopt, maintain
or contribute to for the benefit of its employees generally, subject to satisfying the applicable eligibility requirements and paying any required <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">co-pay,</FONT> premium or other cost. The Bank may, in its sole
discretion and from time to time, amend or eliminate any of these benefits. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.5 <U>Flexible Work Schedule</U>. The Bank does not provide
paid vacation or paid time off (PTO) benefits; however, Executive is encouraged to utilize the Bank&#8217;s Flexible Work Schedule policy. In order to provide Executive with a flexible work schedule, the Bank shall allow Executive the ability to
decide when and how much time to take off, without loss of pay, subject to the Bank&#8217;s business needs and Executive&#8217;s ability to meet those needs, in accordance with the Bank&#8217;s Flexible Work Schedule policy. Executive understands
and acknowledges that time off under the Flexible Work Schedule policy is not a form of wages earned and that it will not vest, accrue, or be paid out at the termination of Executive&#8217;s employment. Executive agrees that Executive must schedule
flexible time off in accordance with, and subject to the terms and conditions of, the Bank&#8217;s Flexible Work Schedule policy. The parties agree that Executive&#8217;s work schedule is subject to the prior approval of the Bank&#8217;s President
and Chief Executive Officer. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.6 <U>Bonus.</U> Executive will participate in the Annual Incentive Plan for executives and may be eligible
for a bonus target amount of 40% of Executive&#8217;s Base Salary evaluated annually by the Board in its sole discretion (a &#8220;<B>Bonus</B>&#8221;), beginning with respect to calendar year 2026 performance. Eligibility for payment will be
determined by the Bank&#8217;s and/or Holding Company&#8217;s performance and Executive&#8217;s individual performance, which will be measured by achievement against any performance metrics as may be determined by the Board or Chief Executive
Officer, depending on Executive&#8217;s role, communicated by the Bank&#8217;s President and Chief Executive Officer. Before a Bonus is earned by Executive, all of the following conditions must be satisfied: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.6.1 None of the Bank&#8217;s or Holding Company&#8217;s relevant annual audited financial statements are (i)&nbsp;required to be restated
due to material noncompliance with any financial reporting requirement under the securities laws, or (ii)&nbsp;actually restated to correct material noncompliance with applicable accounting principles; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.6.2 Executive did not engage in any intentional and/or willful gross misconduct in violation of the Bank&#8217;s or Holding Company&#8217;s
Code of Ethics or similar policy; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.6.3 In the course of employment with the Bank, Executive did not commit any gross ethical violations
that are materially harmful to the Bank&#8217;s or Holding Company&#8217;s reputation or business; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.6.4 Executive did not commit
criminal actions constituting fraud, embezzlement or a felony; and </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">2 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.6.5 Because the Bonus is a retention incentive, Executive is employed at the time the
Bonus is paid, except as provided in <U>Paragraph 5.5.1</U>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Bonus, if any, will be advanced to Executive within two and <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">one-half</FONT> months after the end of the applicable calendar year, subject to clawback pursuant to <U>Paragraph 5.8.2</U> if a determination is made by the Board that one or more of the above conditions have not been
satisfied and, therefore, the Bonus, or a portion thereof, has not been earned by Executive. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.7 <U>Long-Term Incentive Plan Equity
Bonus</U>. Executive shall be entitled to be awarded restricted stock units in the form and on terms provided to other executives (&#8220;<B>LTIP Awards</B>&#8221;) under PBAM&#8217;s Long-Term Incentive Plan, as in effect from time to time (the
&#8220;<B>LTIP Plan</B>&#8221;) each calendar year, beginning with LTIP Awards to be made in calendar year 2027, in an amount up to 40% of his Base Salary should the LTIP Awards become fully vested and payable at the target amount payable. The terms
of the LTIP Awards shall be set each year by the PBAM board of directors or a committee thereof, in its sole discretion. To vest in an LTIP Award Executive must remain employed by the Bank through the vesting date, subject to the terms of the LTIP
Plan. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4. <U>Termination</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4.1 <U>Termination by the Bank</U>. Subject to <U>Paragraph 5</U>, the Board may terminate Executive&#8217;s employment with the Bank prior to
the Expiration Date at will, with or without Cause, including but not limited to, in connection with a Disability of Executive if permissible under applicable law, upon delivery of written notice to Executive (except in the case of the death of
Executive, in which event termination shall automatically occur on the date of death), and if such termination of employment is for Cause or due to Disability, such notice shall state the reason for termination. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4.2 <U>Termination by Executive</U>. Executive may terminate Executive&#8217;s employment with the Bank prior to the Expiration Date at will,
with or without notice or Good Reason. Although not required, it is requested that Executive deliver written notice to the Bank one month in advance of the date such termination is to take effect, where possible. In the event of such termination,
all compensation and benefits shall cease as of the date Executive ceases providing services. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4.3 <U>Termination Upon Expiration</U>. If
Executive remains employed pursuant to this Agreement through the Expiration Date, and if Executive and the Bank have not entered into an amendment of this Agreement extending the Expiration Date or another written agreement replacing this
Agreement, Executive&#8217;s employment shall automatically terminate on the Expiration Date. Nothing in this paragraph&nbsp;shall prejudice the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">at-will</FONT> status of Executive or require the Bank to negotiate
with Executive. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4.4 <U>Automatic Resignations</U>. If Executive&#8217;s employment with the Bank terminates for any reason, including
without limitation, the the Bank&#8217;s termination of Executive&#8217;s employment with or without Cause or the Executive&#8217;s resignation, Executive shall, automatically and without further action by any party, be deemed to have resigned from
all directorships, offices and other capacities with the Bank and any of its subsidiaries and affiliates, including any Holding Company. Executive agrees to provide any documentation confirming such resignations to the Bank immediately upon request.
If Executive fails to submit any documentation confirming such resignations to the Bank immediately upon request, this <U>Paragraph 4.4</U> shall constitute Executive&#8217;s written notice to the Board that Executive is resigning from all
directorships, offices and other capacities with the Bank and any of its subsidiaries and affiliates, including any Holding Company, effective immediately. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4.5 <U>Termination Date</U>. Executive&#8217;s &#8220;Termination Date&#8221; shall be: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4.5.1 If Executive terminates his or her employment hereunder with or without Good Reason, the date Executive ceases to provide services; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4.5.2 If the Bank terminates Executive&#8217;s employment hereunder for Cause, the date the notice of termination is delivered to Executive;
</P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">3 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4.5.3 If the Bank terminates Executive&#8217;s employment hereunder without Cause, the date
specified in the notice of termination; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4.5.4 If Executive&#8217;s employment hereunder terminates on account of Executive&#8217;s death,
the date of Executive&#8217;s death; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4.5.5 If Executive&#8217;s employment hereunder is terminated on account of Executive&#8217;s
Disability, the date that it is determined that Executive has a Disability; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4.5.6 If Executive&#8217;s employment hereunder terminates
upon expiration of the Agreement, the Expiration Date. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Notwithstanding anything contained herein, the Termination Date shall not be deemed to occur until
the date on which Executive incurs a &#8220;separation from service&#8221; within the meaning of Internal Revenue Code Section&nbsp;409A, as amended (&#8220;<B>Section</B><B>&nbsp;409A</B>&#8221;). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5. <U>Post-Termination Payments and Benefits</U>. The following, which are all subject to <U>Paragraph 5.8</U>, are the post-termination
payments and benefits to which Executive is entitled upon termination of employment. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5.1 <U>Termination for Cause</U>. If
Executive&#8217;s employment is terminated for Cause, the Bank shall provide Executive only the accrued but unpaid Base Salary due at the end of the month in which such termination occurs, which shall be paid on the next scheduled payroll date
following the Termination Date. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5.1.1 <U>Cause</U>. For purposes of this Agreement, <B>&#8220;Cause&#8221;</B> means an act of
embezzlement, fraud, dishonesty, or breach of fiduciary duty to the Bank, willful or habitual neglect of duties (other than as a result of Disability or death), a deliberate disregard of the rules of the Bank or Holding Company which results in a
material loss, damage or injury to the Bank or Holding Company, any unauthorized disclosure of any of the Trade Secrets and other proprietary and Confidential Information (each such term as defined in <U>Paragraph 6.5</U>) of the Bank or Holding
Company, inducing any client or customer of the Bank to break any contract with the Bank or inducing any principal for whom the Bank acts as agent to terminate such agency relations, or engaging in any conduct which constitutes unfair competition
with the Bank, or any act which results in Executive being removed from any office of the Bank by or upon the order of any bank regulatory agency. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5.2 <U>Termination Resulting from Disability</U>. If Executive&#8217;s employment is terminated without Cause due to Disability, the Bank
shall provide Executive only the following: (i)&nbsp;the Base Salary for the full month in which such termination occurs,<SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top"> </SUP>which shall be paid on the next scheduled payroll date following the
Termination Date; and (ii)&nbsp;if Executive timely and properly elects continuation coverage under the Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act of 1985, as amended (&#8220;<B>COBRA</B>&#8221;), reimbursement for COBRA premiums paid by
Executive until the earliest of (a)&nbsp;six months following the Termination Date and (b)&nbsp;the date on which Executive becomes eligible to receive group health coverage from another employer; all provided that a full and complete release of
claims against the Bank and its affiliates in the form of <U>Exhibit A</U> is executed and delivered to the Bank within 45 days of Executive&#8217;s receipt of the release, and provided further that Executive has not initiated any suit, arbitration
or other dispute resolution procedure against the Bank or any of its affiliates<B>. </B>Notwithstanding the foregoing, no payments under <U>this Paragraph 5.2</U> shall be made prior to the effective date of such release of claims, as provided
therein. As used in this Agreement,<B> &#8220;Disability,&#8221;</B> means an inability to perform the essential functions of the job, with or without reasonable accommodation, by reason of any medically determinable physical or mental impairment
that can be expected to last for a continuous period of not less than 12 months. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5.3 <U>Termination Resulting from Death</U>. If
Executive&#8217;s employment is terminated due to death, the Bank shall provide only the following: (i)&nbsp;to the Beneficiary, as defined herein, the Base Salary for the full month in which such termination occurs, which shall be paid on the next
scheduled payroll date following the Termination Date; and (ii)&nbsp;if the Beneficiary is covered by the Bank&#8217;s group health insurance benefits at the time of Executive&#8217;s death and timely and properly elects continuation coverage under
COBRA, reimbursement for COBRA premiums paid by the Beneficiary for a period of 180 days following the date of death. <B>&#8220;Beneficiary&#8221;</B> means the person entitled to receive rights or benefits under this Agreement, as set forth in this
Agreement, in the event of the death of Executive. Executive hereby designates Shelby Stewart as the Beneficiary until Executive notifies the Bank in a signed writing otherwise. </P>
<P STYLE="font-size:12pt; margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">4 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5.4 <U>Termination Without Cause or by Executive for Good Reason</U>. If Executive&#8217;s
employment is terminated by the Bank without Cause (other than due to death or Disability) or by Executive for Good Reason, the Bank shall provide Executive only the following: (i)&nbsp;any accrued but unpaid Base Salary, which shall be paid on next
scheduled payroll date following the Termination Date; (ii)&nbsp;a lump sum payment equal to 18 months of Base Salary, plus the pro rata portion of the Bonus (calculated on a daily basis) that Executive would have earned with respect to the portion
of the calendar year elapsed through the Termination Date under the most recently approved bonus plan, if any, and based on performance <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">year-to-date,</FONT></FONT> and if that amount
is not susceptible to calculation, a prorated Bonus based on the prior year&#8217;s Bonus, if any, paid within two months of the Termination Date, provided that a full and complete release of claims against the Bank and its affiliates in the form of
<U>Exhibit A</U> is executed and delivered to the Bank within 45 days of Executive&#8217;s receipt of the release, and provided further that Executive has not initiated any suit, arbitration or other dispute resolution procedure against the Bank or
any of its affiliates; and (iii)&nbsp;if Executive timely and properly elects continuation coverage under COBRA, reimbursement for COBRA premiums paid by Executive until the earliest of (a) 12 months, in the case of termination without Cause, or six
months, in the case of termination for Good Reason, following the Termination Date and (b)&nbsp;the date on which Executive becomes eligible to receive group health coverage from another employer. Notwithstanding the foregoing, no payments under
<U>Paragraph 5.4(ii) or (iii)</U>&nbsp;shall be made prior to the effective date of such release of claims, as provided therein. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5.5
<U>Change in Control </U><U>Termination</U>. If Executive&#8217;s employment is terminated within one year after the consummation of a Change in Control, as defined in <U>Paragraph 5.5.3</U>, by the Bank without Cause (excluding death or Disability)
or by Executive for Good Reason (each a &#8220;<B>Change in Control Termination</B>&#8221;), the Bank shall pay Executive the Change in Control Severance Payments, as defined in <U>Paragraph 5.5.1</U>, within two months of the Change in Control
Termination, provided that: (i)&nbsp;a full and complete release of claims against the Bank and its affiliates in the form of <U>Exhibit A</U> is executed and delivered to the Bank within 45 days of Executive&#8217;s receipt of the release of
claims; and (ii)&nbsp;Executive has not initiated any suit, arbitration or other dispute resolution procedure against the Bank or any of its affiliates. Notwithstanding the foregoing, no payment under this <U>Paragraph 5.5</U> shall be made prior to
the effective date of such release of claims, as provided therein. Such Change in Control Severance Benefits shall be in lieu of and not in addition to any otherwise applicable compensation that would be provided under <U>Paragraph 5.4</U>
notwithstanding the provisions of that paragraph. Change in Control Severance Benefits shall not be payable with respect to a Change in Control Termination occurring more than one year after the date of a Change in Control. Termination of employment
at the Expiration Date shall not be deemed a Change in Control Termination. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5.5.1 &#8220;<U>Change in Control Severance
Benefits</U>&#8221; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:22%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">In addition to any accrued but unpaid Base Salary, which shall be paid on the Termination Date, Executive will
receive (i)&nbsp;a lump sum payment in an amount equal to 24 months of Executive&#8217;s then current Base Salary, plus the full target Bonus that Executive could have earned with respect to the calendar year in which the Termination Date occurs
under the most recently approved bonus plan; and (iii)&nbsp;if Executive timely and properly elects continuation coverage under COBRA, reimbursement of COBRA premiums paid by Executive until the earliest of (a) 12 months following the Termination
Date and (b)&nbsp;the date on which Executive becomes eligible to receive group health coverage from another employer. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5.5.2 <U>Golden
Parachute Limitations</U>. The payments and benefits provided under this <U>Paragraph 5.5</U> shall be considered to be in full and complete satisfaction of any and all rights that Executive may have under the terms of this Agreement.
Notwithstanding the foregoing, to the extent that the aggregate present value of any or all payments and benefits in the nature of compensation to (or for the benefit of) Executive provided under this Agreement or otherwise provided to Executive by
or on behalf of the Bank or any affiliate, parent or controlling entity of the Bank, constitute a &#8220;parachute payment&#8221; under the provisions of Section&nbsp;280G of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended (the
&#8220;<B>Code</B>&#8221;), and the regulations thereunder, the parties agree that the payments or benefits provided to Executive pursuant to this Agreement shall be reduced (in such manner as the Bank shall determine) so that the present value of
the total amount received or retained by Executive that would constitute a &#8220;parachute payment&#8221; will be $1.00 less than three times Executive&#8217;s base amount (as defined in Section&nbsp;280G of the Code) and so that no portion of the
payments or benefits received or retained by Executive would be subject to the excise tax imposed by Section&nbsp;4999 of the Code. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">5 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5.5.3 <U>Change in Control Definitions</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:22%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) &#8220;<U>Change in Control</U>&#8221; means the first occurrence of an event set forth in any one of the following paragraphs: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:26%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i) any Person is or becomes the Beneficial Owner, directly or indirectly, of securities of the Company (not including in the securities
Beneficially Owned by such Person which were acquired directly from the Company or any Affiliate thereof) representing more than fifty percent (50%) of the combined voting power of the Company&#8217;s then outstanding securities, excluding any
Person who becomes such a Beneficial Owner in connection with a transaction described in clause (i)&nbsp;of paragraph (3)&nbsp;below; or </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:26%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(ii) the date on which individuals who constitute the Board as of the Effective Date and any new director (other than a director whose initial
assumption of office is in connection with an actual or threatened election contest, including, but not limited to, a consent solicitation, relating to the election of directors of the Company) whose appointment or election by the Board or
nomination for election by the Company&#8217;s shareholders was approved or recommended by a vote of at least <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">two-thirds</FONT> (2/3) of the directors then still in office who either were directors on the Effective
Date or whose appointment, election or nomination for election was previously so approved or recommended cease for any reason to constitute a majority of the number of directors serving on the Board; or </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:26%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(iii) there is consummated a merger or consolidation of the Company or any direct or indirect Subsidiary with any other corporation or other
entity, other than (i)&nbsp;a merger or consolidation (A)&nbsp;which results in the voting securities of the Company outstanding immediately prior to such merger or consolidation continuing to represent (either by remaining outstanding or by being
converted into voting securities of the surviving entity or any parent thereof), in combination with the ownership of any trustee or other fiduciary holding securities under an employee benefit plan of the Company or any Subsidiary, fifty percent
(50%) or more of the combined voting power of the securities of the Company or such surviving entity or any parent thereof outstanding immediately after such merger or consolidation and (B)&nbsp;following which the individuals who comprise the Board
immediately prior thereto constitute at least a majority of the board of directors of the Company, the entity surviving such merger or consolidation or, if the Company or the entity surviving such merger or consolidation is then a Subsidiary, the
ultimate parent thereof, or (ii)&nbsp;a merger or consolidation effected to implement a recapitalization of the Company (or similar transaction) in which no Person is or becomes the Beneficial Owner, directly or indirectly, of securities of the
Company (not including in the securities Beneficially Owned by such Person any securities acquired directly from the Company or its Affiliates) representing more than fifty percent (50%) of the combined voting power of the Company&#8217;s then
outstanding securities; or </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:26%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(iv) the shareholders of the Company approve a plan of complete liquidation or dissolution of the Company or
there is consummated an agreement for the sale or disposition by the Company of all or substantially all of the Company&#8217;s assets, other than (A)&nbsp;a sale or disposition by the Company of all or substantially all of the Company&#8217;s
assets to an entity, more than fifty percent (50%) of the combined voting power of the voting securities of which are owned by shareholders of the Company following the completion of such transaction in substantially the same proportions as their
ownership of the Company immediately prior to such sale or (B)&nbsp;a sale or disposition of all or substantially all of the Company&#8217;s assets immediately following which the individuals who comprise the Board immediately prior thereto
constitute at least a majority of the board of directors of the entity to which such assets are sold or disposed or, if such entity is a subsidiary, the ultimate parent thereof. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Notwithstanding the foregoing, a Change in Control shall not be deemed to have occurred by virtue of the consummation of any transaction or series of
integrated transactions immediately following which the holders of Common Stock immediately prior to such transaction or series of transactions continue to have substantially the same proportionate ownership in an entity which owns all or
substantially all of the assets of the Company immediately following such transaction or series of transactions. For purposes of this definition of Change in Control, the term &#8220;Person&#8221; shall not include (i)&nbsp;the Company or any
Subsidiary thereof, (ii)&nbsp;a trustee or other fiduciary holding securities under an employee benefit plan of the Company or any Subsidiary thereof, (iii)&nbsp;an underwriter temporarily holding securities pursuant to an offering of such
securities, or (iv)&nbsp;a corporation owned, directly or indirectly, by the shareholders of the Company in substantially the same proportions as their ownership of shares of the Company. Notwithstanding anything herein to the contrary, a
transaction shall not constitute a Change in Control if its sole purpose is to change the state of the Company&#8217;s incorporation or to create a holding company that will be owned in substantially the same proportions by the persons who held the
Company&#8217;s securities immediately before such transactions. In addition, none of (A)&nbsp;a bona fide equity financing for capital raising purposes, (B)&nbsp;an Initial Public Offering by the Company, or (C)&nbsp;the acquisition of shares of
Common Stock by Selwyn Isakow and/or Ernest Rady and/or any of their Affiliates, shall constitute a Change in Control. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">6 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">For purposes of Section&nbsp;409A of the Code, and solely with respect to any payment or benefit provided
under this Agreement that constitutes nonqualified deferred compensation subject to Section&nbsp;409A of the Code and whose payment, timing, or form is triggered or affected by a Change in Control, no Change in Control shall be deemed to have
occurred for such purpose unless the event also constitutes a &#8220;change in control event&#8221; within the meaning of Treasury Regulation <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Section&nbsp;1.409A-3(i)(5).</FONT> </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:22%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) &#8220;<U>Affiliate</U>&#8221; means a Person that directly, or indirectly through one or more intermediaries, controls, or is controlled
by, or is under common control with, the Person specified as of any date of determination. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:22%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) &#8220;<U>Beneficial Owner</U>&#8221; (or
any variant thereof) has the meaning defined in Rule <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">13d-3</FONT> under the Exchange Act. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:22%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d)
&#8220;<U>Board</U>&#8221; means the Board of Directors of the Company. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:22%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(e) &#8220;<U>Company</U>&#8221; means Private Bancorp of
America, Inc., a California corporation (or any successor company, except as the term &#8220;Company&#8221; is used in the definition of &#8220;Change in Control&#8221; above). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:22%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(f) &#8220;<U>Effective Date</U>&#8221; means the date the Plan is approved by the Company&#8217;s shareholders. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:22%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(g) &#8220;<U>Exchange Act</U>&#8221; means the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended from time to time. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:22%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(h) <U>&#8220;Good Reason&#8221;</U>. &#8220;Good Reason&#8221; means any one of the following events described in subparts (i)&nbsp;through
(iii) (any one of which will constitute Good Reason) has first occurred without Executive&#8217;s written consent: (i)&nbsp;a reduction of 5% or more in Executive&#8217;s Base Salary below the rate then in effect in accordance with <U>Paragraph
3.1</U>, provided that, in the event the salaries of all executives with the title of Executive Vice President or above are reduced by at least 5%, such a reduction shall not constitute Good Reason; (ii)&nbsp;the Bank requiring that Executive be
based outside of Seattle, Washington or within 75 miles of the geographic center of that City, or the Bank requiring that Executive work out of an office of the Bank not within that geographic area for more than two (2)&nbsp;days per week on average
in any calendar quarter; or (iii)&nbsp;a reduction in title such that Executive no longer has the title of Chief Financial Officer. Notwithstanding the foregoing, no Good Reason shall exist unless (A)&nbsp;Executive has given written notice to the
Bank of the existence of the Good Reason event or condition affecting Executive within ninety (90)&nbsp;days of its initial existence, (B)&nbsp;the Bank has been provided a period of at least thirty (30)&nbsp;days to remedy the Good Reason event or
condition and has not remedied the Good Reason event or condition, and (C)&nbsp;if the Bank fails to remedy the Good Reason event or condition during the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">30-day</FONT> cure period, Executive terminates employment
within thirty (30)&nbsp;days following the end of such <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">30-day</FONT> cure period. If Executive fails to timely provide such written notice to the Bank or fails to timely resign Executive&#8217;s employment for Good
Reason, Executive will be deemed to have consented to and waived the Good Reason event or condition. If the Bank timely cures or remedies the Good Reason event or condition, then Executive may either resign Executive&#8217;s employment without Good
Reason or remain employed subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:22%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i) &#8220;<U>Initial Public Offering</U>&#8221; means a
transaction, occurrence or event that results in the Company being subject to the requirements of Section&nbsp;12 or Section&nbsp;15(d) of the Exchange Act. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:22%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(j) &#8220;<U>Person</U>&#8221; shall have the meaning given in Section&nbsp;3(a)(9) of the Exchange Act, as modified and used in Sections
13(d) and 14(d) thereof. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">7 </P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:22%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(k) &#8220;<U>Subsidiary</U>&#8221; means, with respect to any Person, as of any date of
determination, any other Person as to which such first Person owns or otherwise controls, directly or indirectly, more than 50% of the voting shares or other similar interests or a sole general partner interest or managing member or similar interest
of such other Person. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5.6 <U>Nonassignability</U>. Neither Executive nor any other person or entity shall have any power or right to
transfer, assign, anticipate, hypothecate, mortgage, commute, modify, or otherwise encumber in advance any of the rights or benefits of Executive under this <U>Paragraph</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;5</U>, nor shall any of said rights or benefits be subject
to seizure for the payment of any debts, judgments, alimony or separate maintenance owed by Executive or any other person or entity, or be transferable by operation of law in the event of bankruptcy, insolvency or otherwise. The terms of this
<U>Paragraph</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;5.6</U> shall not affect the interpretation of any provision of this Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5.7 <U>Claims
Procedure</U>. The Board shall make all initial determinations as to rights to benefits under this <U>Paragraph</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;5</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5.8 <U>Regulatory Restrictions and Clawback</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5.8.1 <U>Regulatory Golden Parachute Limitations</U>. The parties understand and agree that at the time any payment would otherwise be made or
benefit provided under <U>Paragraph</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;5</U> or <U>Paragraph</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;6.3</U>, depending on the facts and circumstances existing at such time, the satisfaction of such obligations by the Bank may be deemed by a regulatory
authority to be illegal, an unsafe and unsound practice or, for some other reason, not properly due or payable by the Bank. Among other things, the regulations at 12 C.F.R. Part 30, Appendix A promulgated pursuant to Section&nbsp;39(a) of the
Federal Deposit Insurance Act, and at 12 C.F.R. Part 359, or similar regulations or regulatory action following similar principles may apply at such time. The Bank agrees that, to the extent reasonably feasible, it will in good faith seek to
determine the position of the appropriate regulatory authority in advance of each payment or benefit otherwise due under <U>Paragraph</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;5</U> or <U>Paragraph</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;6.3</U>, including seeking the approval or acquiescence
of the appropriate regulatory authorities, if required. The parties understand, acknowledge and agree that notwithstanding any other provision of this Agreement, the Bank shall not be obligated to make any payment or provide any benefit under
<U>Paragraph</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;5</U> or <U>Paragraph</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;6.3</U> where (i)&nbsp;an appropriate regulatory authority does not approve or acquiesce as required or (ii)&nbsp;the Bank has been informed orally or in writing by a
representative of the appropriate regulatory authority that it is the position of such regulatory authority that making such payment or providing such benefit would constitute an unsafe and unsound practice, violate a written agreement with the
regulatory authority, violate an applicable rule or regulation, or would cause the representative of the regulatory authority to recommend enforcement action against the Bank. At the Termination Date, if the Bank is in a &#8220;troubled
condition,&#8221; or otherwise subject to informal or formal regulatory action, as determined by its primary federal or state regulator, the regulator&#8217;s later change in that determination shall not affect the restrictions on the obligations of
the Bank above. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5.8.2 <U>Bank Clawback Policy</U>. Executive agrees that Executive is subject to, and will comply with, the Clawback
Policy of the Bank and PBAM as currently in effect and as amended or replaced from time to time. Executive further acknowledges that any incentive-based compensation (as defined in Rule <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">10D-1</FONT> under the
Exchange Act) received by Executive under this Agreement or otherwise is subject to recovery by the Bank or any Holding Company to the extent required by Section&nbsp;10D of the Exchange Act, Rule <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">10D-1</FONT>
promulgated thereunder, and any clawback policy adopted by the Bank or any Holding Company in compliance therewith, as may be amended from time to time. No additional consideration shall be required in connection with any such recovery. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5.9 <U>Right of Offset</U>. Any and all of the compensation and benefits that would otherwise be provided under
<U>Paragraph</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;5</U>, with the exception of amounts due under applicable law, are subject to the Bank&#8217;s offset for any liability of Executive to the Bank caused by Executive&#8217;s dishonesty, willful act or gross negligence,
to the extent the Board determines that such liability exists. In addition, without limiting the remedies of the Bank available under this Agreement or otherwise, all compensation and benefits that would otherwise be payable under
<U>Paragraph</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;5, </U>with the exception of amounts due under applicable law, shall cease as of the date Executive first violates any of the provisions included in <U>Paragraph</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;6.5</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5.10 <U>Overlapping Benefits and Payments</U>. In the event that Executive receives payments and/or benefits under one of
<U>Paragraphs</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;5.1</U> through <U>5.5, and 5.12</U> or under a salary continuation agreement or other agreement to the extent it specifically references this <U>Paragraph</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;5.10</U>, Executive may not receive
payments and/or benefits under one of the other of such paragraphs or such agreement, and the first such applicable of those paragraphs or such other agreement shall apply. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">8 </P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5.11 <U>Delayed Payments</U>. In the event that Section&nbsp;409A applies to any
compensation payable with respect to a separation from service, payment of that compensation shall be delayed if Executive is a &#8220;specified employee,&#8221; as defined in Section&nbsp;409A(a)(2)(B)(i), and such delayed payment is required by
Section&nbsp;409A. Such delay shall last six months from the date of separation from service. On the first day following the end of such <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">six-month</FONT> period, the Bank shall make a
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">catch-up</FONT> payment to Executive equal to the total amount of such payments that would have been made during the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">six-month</FONT> period but for this
<U>Paragraph</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;5.11</U>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5.12 <U>Death Following Termination</U>. If Executive dies while receiving any payments under
this <U>Paragraph</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;5</U>, such payments shall be paid to the Beneficiary, as defined in <U>Paragraph 5.3</U>, as would otherwise be required under this <U>Paragraph</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;5</U>. Unless prohibited by the applicable
plan, if Executive was covered by the Bank&#8217;s group health insurance benefits under COBRA at the time of Executive&#8217;s death, the Bank shall reimburse the COBRA premiums paid by the Beneficiary for a period of 180 days following the date of
death. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">6. <U>Additional Covenants</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">6.1 <U>Keyman Life Insurance</U>. The Bank shall have the right to obtain and hold a &#8220;keyman&#8221; life insurance policy on the life of
Executive with the Bank as beneficiary of the policy. Executive agrees to provide any information&nbsp;or submit to any physical examination required for such policy. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">6.2 <U>Unsecured General Creditor</U>. Neither Executive nor any other person or entity shall have any legal right or equitable rights,
interests or claims in or to any property or assets of the Bank under the provisions of this Agreement. No assets of the Bank shall be held under any trust for the benefit of Executive or any other person or entity or held in any way as security for
the fulfilling of the obligations of the Bank under this Agreement. All of the Bank&#8217;s assets shall be and remain the general, unpledged, unrestricted assets of the Bank. The Bank&#8217;s obligations under this Agreement are unfunded and
unsecured promises and, to the extent such promises involve the payment of money, they are promises to pay money in the future. Executive and any person or entity claiming through Executive shall be unsecured general creditors with respect to any
rights or benefits hereunder. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">6.3 <U>Indemnification</U>. Separately, PBAM and Executive have entered into an Indemnification Agreement
in the form for &#8220;Executive Officers.&#8221; This <U>Paragraph</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;6.3</U> shall not limit any other rights to indemnification that Executive may now or hereafter have by law or under the articles, bylaws or resolutions of the
Bank or otherwise. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">6.4 <U>Dispute Resolution</U>. Any and all disputes covered by the Executive Arbitration Agreement attached as
<U>Exhibit</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;B,</U> and incorporated herein by reference, shall be resolved in accordance with that document. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">6.5
<U>Business Protection Covenants</U>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">6.5.1 <U>Protection of Confidential Information and Trade Secrets</U> </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:22%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) <U>Definitions.</U> </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:26%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i)
&#8220;<B>Confidential Information</B>&#8221; means any and all information whether prepared, conceived or developed by an employee of the Bank or predecessor of the Bank (including Executive) or received by the Bank or predecessor of the Bank from
an outside source, and which is not generally known to the public and, as a result, is of economic benefit to the Bank in the conduct of its business, including, without limitation, Trade Secrets, information relating to the business of the Bank,
any of its customers, governmental relations, customer contacts, underwriting methodology, loan program configuration and qualification strategies, marketing strategies and proposals, or any other information concerning the business of the Bank, its
subsidiaries, affiliates and/or predecessors, or the Bank&#8217;s good will. Confidential Information does not include any information which (x)&nbsp;was in the lawful and unrestricted possession of Executive prior to its disclosure to Executive by
the Bank or its affiliates or predecessors, (y)&nbsp;is or becomes generally available to the public by lawful acts other than those of Executive after receiving it, or (z)&nbsp;has been received lawfully and in good faith by Executive from a third
party who is not and has never been an employee of the Bank or its affiliates or predecessors and who did not derive it from the Bank or its affiliates or predecessors. Confidential Information does not include general industry skills, experience,
or <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">know-how,</FONT> and does not include information that is generally available to the public. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">9 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:26%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(ii) &#8220;<B>Trade Secret</B>&#8221; has that meaning set forth under applicable law. It
includes all information that may be considered a Trade Secret under applicable law. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:22%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) <U>Confidentiality, <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-Disclosure</FONT> and Adverse Use</U>. During the term of employment with the Bank, Executive will have access to and become acquainted with various Trade Secrets and Confidential Information owned by the Bank and used
in the operation of the Bank&#8217;s business, the wrongful use or disclosure of which to the public or competitors of the Bank would materially adversely affect the business and prospects of the Bank. Executive acknowledges and agrees that the Bank
is entitled to prevent the unauthorized use and disclosure of its Confidential Information and Trade Secrets. As part of the consideration for Executive&#8217;s employment and for the compensation being paid to Executive by the Bank, Executive
agrees to hold in strictest confidence and will not disclose or use in any manner, directly or indirectly, any such Confidential Information or Trade Secrets either during the term of Executive&#8217;s employment with the Bank or at any time
thereafter, except as authorized and required in the course of employment with the Bank, and will not at any time use any of the Bank&#8217;s Confidential Information or Trade Secrets in any manner that may directly or indirectly have an adverse
effect upon the Bank&#8217;s business, nor will Executive perform any acts that would tend to reduce the value of the Bank&#8217;s Confidential Information or Trade Secrets. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:22%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) <U>Immunity Notice</U>. Pursuant to the Defend Trade Secrets Act of 2016, an individual may not be held criminally or civilly liable under
any federal or state trade secret law for the disclosure of a Trade Secret that (i)&nbsp;is made (x)&nbsp;in confidence to a federal, state or local government official, either directly or indirectly, or to an attorney, and (y)&nbsp;solely for the
purpose of reporting or investigating a suspected violation of law, or (ii)&nbsp;is made in a complaint or other document filed in a lawsuit or other proceeding, if such filing is made under seal. An individual who files a lawsuit for retaliation by
an employer for reporting a suspected violation of law may disclose the Trade Secret to the attorney of the individual and use the Trade Secret information in the court proceeding, if the individual (i)&nbsp;files any document containing the Trade
Secret under seal, and (ii)&nbsp;does not disclose the Trade Secret, except pursuant to court order. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">6.5.2 <U>Return of Bank
Property</U>. Executive expressly agrees that all manuals, document, files, reports, studies, customer lists, business plans, loan and deposit program plans and outlines, customer solicitation and <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">follow-up</FONT>
techniques and plans, marketing plans, investment banker and financial advisor relationships and arrangements, employee policies, incentive compensation arrangements, instruments, software, and other materials used and/or developed by Executive
during Executive&#8217;s employment with the Bank, whether in paper, computer readable, computer coded, magnetic, compact disk or other tangible or electronic form are solely the property of the Bank, and Executive has no right, title or interest
therein. Executive hereby further acknowledges that all such items constitute confidential Trade Secrets and/or Confidential Information, the wrongful use or disclosure of which to the public or competitors of the Bank would materially adversely
affect the business and prospects of the Bank. Upon termination of employment of Executive, Executive or Executive&#8217;s representatives shall promptly deliver possession of all said property, in whatever form, to the Bank in good condition. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">6.5.3 <U>Inducing Employees to Leave the Bank; Employment of Employees</U>. Executive acknowledges that any attempt on the part of Executive
to interfere with or raid any employees of the Bank or any of its subsidiaries or affiliates, or any effort by Executive to interfere with the Bank&#8217;s relationship with its other employees would be harmful and damaging to the Bank. Executive
agrees that to the fullest extent allowed by applicable law, during the term of employment and for a period of eight months thereafter, Executive will not in any way disrupt, damage, impair, or interfere with the business of the Bank or any one of
its subsidiaries or affiliates by, directly or indirectly, interfering with, soliciting, recruiting, attempting to recruit or raiding any employee of the Bank or any employee of its subsidiaries or affiliates or otherwise interfere with or disrupt
the relationships between the Bank and its subsidiaries and affiliates and their respective employees. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">10 </P>

</DIV></Center>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">6.5.4 <U>Equitable Relief</U>. Executive acknowledges and agrees that irreparable injury
will result to the Bank in the event of a breach of any of the provisions of <U>Paragraph</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;6.5.1</U> or <U>Paragraph 6.5.3</U> (the &#8220;<B>Designated Provisions</B>&#8221;) and that the Bank will have no adequate remedy at law
with respect thereto. Accordingly, in the event of a material breach of any Designated Provision, and in addition to any other legal or equitable remedy the Bank or its subsidiaries or affiliates may have, the Bank and any relevant subsidiary or
affiliate shall be entitled to the entry of a preliminary and permanent injunction (including, without limitation, specific performance), without any requirement to post any bond, to restrain the violation or breach thereof by Executive or any
affiliates, agents, or any other persons acting for or with Executive in any capacity whatsoever. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">6.5.5 <U>Severability</U>. It is the
desire and intent of the parties that each of the Designated Provisions shall be enforced to the fullest extent permissible under the laws and public policies applied in each jurisdiction in which enforcement is sought. Accordingly, if any
particular provision in the Designated Provisions shall be adjudicated or found to be invalid or unenforceable, such provisions shall be deemed amended to delete therefrom the portion thus adjudicated or found to be invalid or unenforceable, such
deletion to apply only with respect to the operation of such provision in the particular jurisdiction in which such adjudication or finding is made. In addition, should any court or arbitrator determine that any of the Designated Provisions shall be
unenforceable with respect to scope, duration, or geographic area, such court or arbitrator shall be empowered to substitute, to the extent enforceable, provisions similar hereto or other provisions so as to provide to the Bank, to the fullest
extent permitted by applicable law, the benefits intended by the particular paragraph&nbsp;at issue. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">6.5.6 <U>Section 16 Compliance</U>.
If the Bank or any Holding Company is or becomes subject to the reporting requirements of Section&nbsp;12 or Section&nbsp;15(d) of the Exchange Act, Executive agrees to: (a)&nbsp;comply with all obligations under Section&nbsp;16 of the Exchange Act
and the rules and regulations promulgated thereunder, including all applicable reporting requirements; (b)&nbsp;comply with the Bank&#8217;s and any Holding Company&#8217;s insider trading policy and
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">pre-clearance</FONT> procedures as in effect from time to time; and (c)&nbsp;provide to the Bank, on a timely basis, all information reasonably necessary to permit the Bank to file Section&nbsp;16 reports on
Executive&#8217;s behalf. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">7. <U>Other Agreements</U>. The parties agree that to the extent of any inconsistency between this Agreement and
any employee manual or policy of the Bank, the terms of this Agreement shall supersede the terms of such employee manual or policy. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">8.
<U>No Violation of Rights of Third Parties</U>. Executive warrants that the performance of all the terms of this Agreement and as an employee of the Bank does not and will not breach <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-competition,</FONT> <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-solicitation,</FONT> <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-disclosure,</FONT> or any agreement to keep in confidence proprietary information, knowledge or data acquired by Executive prior to or during Executive&#8217;s
employment with the Bank. Executive agrees not to disclose to the Bank, or induce the Bank to use, any confidential or proprietary information or material belonging to any previous employers or others. Executive warrants that Executive is not a
party to any other agreement that will interfere with Executive&#8217;s full compliance with this Agreement. Executive further agrees not to enter into any agreement, whether written or oral, in conflict with the provisions of this Agreement. </P>

to carry out the provisions of this Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">9.4 <U>Assignment</U>. No party may assign its rights under this Agreement without the
prior written consent of the other party hereto. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">9.5 <U>Successors and Assigns</U>. Except as explicitly provided herein to the contrary,
this Agreement shall be binding upon and inure to the benefit of the parties, their respective successors and permitted assigns. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">9.6
<U>Severability</U>. If any portion of this Agreement shall be held by a court of competent jurisdiction to be invalid, void, or otherwise unenforceable, the remaining provisions shall remain enforceable to the fullest extent permitted by law if
enforcement would not frustrate the overall intent of the parties (as such intent is manifested by all provisions of this Agreement including such invalid, void, or otherwise unenforceable portion). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">9.7 <U>Extension Not a Waiver</U>. No delay or omission in the exercise of any power, remedy, or right herein provided or otherwise available
to any party shall impair or affect the right of such party thereafter to exercise the same. Any extension of time or other indulgence granted to a party hereunder shall not otherwise alter or affect any power, remedy or right of any other party, or
the obligations of the party to whom such extension or indulgence is granted except as specifically waived. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">9.8 <U>Time of Essence</U>.
Time is of the essence of each and every term, condition, obligation and provision hereof. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">9.9 <U>Limited Third-Party Beneficiaries</U>.
This Agreement and each and every provision hereof is for the exclusive benefit of the parties hereto and not for the benefit of any third party, except that PBAM is a third-party beneficiary of this Agreement. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">9.10 <U>Headings</U>. The headings in this Agreement are inserted only as a matter of convenience, and in no way define, limit, extend or
interpret the scope of this Agreement or of any particular provision hereof. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">9.11 <U>References</U>. A reference to a particular
paragraph&nbsp;of this Agreement shall be deemed to include references to all subordinate paragraphs, if any. </P>
